Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut is an official institution dedicated to supporting quality development within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. It acts as a central governmental authority in the implementation and oversight of quality measurement for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) [^src1]. 

The institute is the official publisher of the annual reports for the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD) [^src1]. In this capacity, it collaborated with the DANIBD Steering Committee to produce the database's second annual report for 2024, which serves as the official quality monitoring tool for IBD in Denmark and covers the reporting period from October 1, 2023, to September 30, 2024 [^src1]. The institute's headquarters are located at Hedeager 3, 8200 Aarhus N [^src1].
